{{Quote|Davik doesn't like you missing payments!|The Aqualish, to the merchant|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]], an '''Aqualish bounty hunter''' worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Kang dispatched him and a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Upper City)|Human bounty hunter]] to collect 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from one of his debtors, an [[Unidentified Taris merchant|aged merchant]]. The [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] could not pay the full sum, and the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] intended to take him to Kang, who would [[Death/Legends|kill]] the man as an example to other debtors. However, the merchant was rescued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who killed both the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and his [[Human/Legends|Human]] colleague.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Davik doesn't like witnesses.|The Aqualish, upon noticing Revan|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
[[File:LetsShootTheOldGuyAndTakeHisMoney.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The bounty hunters confront the merchant in the Upper City.]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] worked for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="CG" /> the Aqualish and a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Upper City)|Human bounty hunter]] were sent by Kang to collect a 100-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] debt from an [[Unidentified Taris merchant|elderly merchant]], who had failed to pay it on [[Time/Legends|time]]. The two [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters confronted the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] in the [[Upper City]] and tried to extort the money from him. The merchant, however, had only half the necessary sum, which he offered as a down payment and asked for more time to find the rest. The bounty hunters did not agree to the man's terms and prepared to take him to Kang, who would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him as an example to others who did not pay their debts. Frightened, the merchant cried for help.<ref name="KotOR" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
Fortunately for the merchant, his cry was heard by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was searching for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]] on Taris. Trying to help the man, Revan intervened and told the bounty hunters to release him. The Aqualish and his partner, viewing Revan as an unwanted witness, attacked him. However, Revan killed the two, rescuing the merchant.<ref name="KotOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That's too bad. Davik's going to want to make an example of you. You're coming with us!|The Aqualish, preparing to take the merchant to Kang|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The Aqualish was loyal to Kang and followed his employer's orders to the letter. Despite the merchant's pleas to accept a down payment and give him more time, the bounty hunter was intent to take him to Kang, who would kill the man. The day he died, the Aqualish was carrying a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and fifty credits. The bounty hunter had [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Smart move to mind your own business.|The bounty hunter, to Revan, in a non-canon outcome in which Revan does not intervene in the situation|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
This Aqualish bounty hunter appears as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. This article follows the [[canon]]ical [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] walkthrough, although the player, controlling Revan, can deal with the bounty hunters in the game in several ways. The player may simply attack them out of spite or opt not to intervene in the argument. In the latter scenario, the bounty hunters take the merchant to Kang. Should the player approach the bounty hunters while wearing [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith trooper armor]], they mistake Revan for a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] and remind him that Kang has made a deal with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], according to which both sides do not interfere in each other's business. If Revan continues to impersonate the Sith and orders the Aqualish and his fellow bounty hunter to release the merchant, they attack him, stating that they take orders from Kang only.<ref name="KotOR" />
